_about: Hand-kept viewpoints for the discovery places layer (engine/discover/build.py via discover.json). Each is a place whose own Chicago Park District page describes its view (source: the page), at the park's point in the map's parks layer. 'why' is our own words, kept to what the source says; 'checked' is the day the view and the place were last confirmed against the source (scouting/discovery/stale.py lists any over 180 days old). A short start (November 18, 2026); the user is collecting more from people who live in Chicago. Candidates whose Park District pages don't describe a view, left out until a source does: Promontory Point, Cricket Hill (Montrose), Montrose Harbor (a photo caption only), Milton Lee Olive Park, Ping Tom Memorial Park (only its fieldhouse's rentable patio is described), 31st Street Harbor.
credit: Layers.City, from the Chicago Park District's descriptions

places.name: Northerly Island
places.why: A nature park on the lakefront whose rolling hills frame a view of the downtown skyline.
places.source: Chicago Park District: Northerly Island Park

places.name: Palmisano Park
places.why: A former quarry, now a park with a pond and wetlands; the mound at its top has wide views of the city.
